messages:
oncall-rot: Pager triggered — high outbound egress to multiple external APIs from svc-ingest-prod. ~3.2k requests in last 5m, repeated bearer tokens, some 401->200 pattern. Alert id: alert-1789990000. tagging sec oncall.

security-bot: Detected abnormal request pattern: external endpoints "api.third-party-a.com", "cdn.third-party-b.net", "ingest.partner-c.io" receiving bursts on port 443. Sample header (redacted):
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJ[REDACTED]...
X-Forwarded-For: 35.198.12.4
User-Agent: svc-ingest/1.4.2
```
Rules matched: outbound-rate-anom, token-reuse-score>0.8.

emma: copying logs now. can we isolate the process? if it's svc-ingest-prod we should 1) throttle egress 2) rotate svc token 3) capture forensic snapshot. do not restart until we snapshot. :warning:

raj: i'm on it. i'll spin up a short-lived blocklist on egress WAF for the dst IPs and place svc-ingest-prod in limited mode (reject external calls) — will keep internal calls to infra endpoints only. ETA 8-12m.

dana: hold on rotations until we confirm scope. if logs were forwarded from staging -> prod via misconfigured forwarder yesterday, rotating prod token might not stop exfil. need to confirm whether tokens were exfiltrated to third parties. start memory+file collection, mark preserve for forensics. i'll coordinate with charlie for the snapshot.

charlie-sre: grabbing process list and tcpdump on the host: `sudo gdb --pid $(pgrep -f svc-ingest)` for core if needed; running:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host 35.198.12.4 or host 34.120.55.6 -w /tmp/egress-178999.pcap &
sudo ls -l /var/log/svc-ingest/debug.log | tail -n 1
```
logs show repeated `POST /v1/events` with X-Request-Id present, bodies truncated. pushing full export to-sec-log-bucket for analysis (redacted path).

emma: i'm going to prepare key rotation plan for svc-ingest-prod creds. plan: create new key, deploy, flip traffic, revoke old. can do a staged rotate to avoid customer impact. any objections?

dana: proceed with staged rotate but only after we confirm we have copies of relevant logs (timestamp window 1789989600-1789990000). do not publish revocation to external vendor yet. sec will handle vendor notifications after internal confirmation.

raj: WAF blocklist applied to dst IPs and denylist rule pushed to edge. svc-ingest placed into egress-limited policy. network-side mitigation in place.

security-bot: forensic checklist updated. captured artifacts:
- /tmp/egress-178999.pcap
- /var/log/svc-ingest/debug.log.2026-03-17
- process dump: /tmp/svc-ingest-dump-178999.core
Hashes: md5: 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592 (sample)

emma: starting staged rotation now. creating new service key, will deploy to 2 instances first, then rollout to rest. commands:
```
# create new key
platformctl secrets put svc-ingest/key new-key-2026-03-17
# deploy to canary
deployctl rollout svc-ingest --canary 2
# verify metrics
promql: rate(http_requests_total{service="svc-ingest",code="200"}[1m])
```

charlie-sre: requested to pause any auto-restarts. forensic team: please confirm snapshot taken before rotation.

dana: snapshot confirmed. proceed. also creating internal ticket to check if any customer tokens were included in forwarded logs; contacting logging infra owner (@emma) to audit yesterday's forwarder config change.

legal: please capture who has access to the logs being forwarded. we may need to prepare a notification timeline depending on PII exposure. do not post external notices yet.

oncall-rot: update: canary deploy succeeded, traffic is cut to external endpoints, old key revoked in KMS for production (arn:aws:kms:REDACTED). impact so far: telemetry shows ~98% reduction in outbound calls. no confirmed customer data found in captured artifacts yet.

emma: running search on log archive for any customer identifiers in the window. if nothing, we'll treat as closed-mitigated with follow-ups: full postmortem, forwarder config rollback, improved egress alerts, rotate any tokens that had broad permissions.

raj: handing off to morning sec shift (+dana) for full investigation and vendor outreach if needed. i've created follow-up tasks: TASK-178999-01 (forensics), TASK-178999-02 (postmortem), TASK-178999-03 (config hardening).

dana: setting priority P1 for investigation. will confirm next steps within 2 hours. good work team. :thumbsup:
summary: Initial detection of abnormal outbound egress from svc-ingest-prod to multiple external APIs; WAF blocklist applied, egress limited, staged key rotation carried out with canary, artifacts collected for forensics. No confirmed customer data exposure at time of handoff. Follow-ups assigned to sec and infra.
